description: Score-error sensitivity of the empirical null spectrum; matched-M simple vs trajectory estimators; whitened spectra.
scope_note: Theorem 2 is exact only for its isotropic-Gaussian, independent-pair asymptotic model. These are empirical robustness measurements on injected score error, not an extension of the theorem and not a guarantee for arbitrary unknown score error. Matched Monte Carlo absorbs only error mechanisms that are explicitly simulated.
